problems: xpath '$kv' reads $kv: an extract's names are fields, not variables, and the XSLT declares none by that name, so it wouldn't compile. Read one with field: 'kv' (an extraction takes an earlier extraction's name as its field too); to change the text first, put the change in the xpath that reads the source itself.

[logon] Event/EventDetail/Authenticate needs one of ['User', 'Device', 'Group']. Already mapped elsewhere in the event: EventSource/Device/HostName (field 'host'), EventSource/User/Id (field 'user'). If the action is about one of them, map the same input here as well (EventDetail/Authenticate/Device/HostName or EventDetail/Authenticate/User/Id), and keep the existing mapping: it says something different
warnings: [logon] EventTime/TimeCreated: TimeCreated is a date-time; give time_format (from profile_sample) unless the input is already yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ
[logon] required ['EventTime'] are left out when their input fields are empty, which makes the event invalid. Fine if those fields are always filled; otherwise give the mapping a default.
[logon] Data 'src' looks like EventSource/Client/IPAddress, which the schema has: map it there (Data is for what has no element of its own), or keep it as Data if it means something else.
